parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the permission group.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The ID of the namespace. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 get-worker-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --group-id usercenter --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun schedulerx2 GetWorkerList --region cn-hangzhou --NamespaceSource schedulerx --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace 'adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000' --GroupId usercenter
